nina (partnerships): Looping in @zeke and @sophie. We need a compact CSV feed for Q3 modeling: SKU-level reserved/spot, commitment thresholds, min_guaranteed_capacity_pct, and any early-exit schedules. Can you provide?
zeke (hardware): Hey Nina 1. We'll produce. Do you need per-region breakdown or can we give global blended rates?
sophie (finance): Per-region please. Blended hides latency/cost differences.
nina (partnerships): Agree per-region. Also add field 'eviction_correlation_tag' (NONE,SHORT,LONG) and 'on_call_notice_min'.
zeke (hardware): Noted. Proposed header:
```
sku,region,spot_usd_hr,reserved_usd_hr,commit_hours,commit_label,eviction_correlation_tag,min_guaranteed_capacity_pct,on_call_notice_min,early_exit_schedule_link,one_time_onboarding_usd,notes
```
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/zenith/1725120000_v1.csv  validating... parsed 6 SKUs.
sophie (finance): Pls include 'median_spot' and 'p95_spot' if you can. Helps with tail risk.
zeke (hardware): We'll add median/p95 in v2 along with any region blackout windows.
nina (partnerships): Also include 'allow_marketplace_listing' TRUE/FALSE and 'playlist_for_joint_announce' for campaign planning.
zeke (hardware): Will do. Uploading v2 now.
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/zenith/1725120000_v2.csv  validating... warnings: 1 SKU missing p95_spot. Parsed 6 SKUs.
sophie (finance): Great. We will ingest and run the Q3 baseline tomorrow. Nina, we'll need mapping to our internal sku codes.
nina (partnerships): I'll map and return CSV with internal ids. Thanks!
